event.description:
Join us for an official Grand Archive Regional and compete for cash prizing, exclusive promos, and regional glory!

Entry Fee: $40
Check-in: 10:00 AM
Round 1 Begins: 11:00 AM

What’s Included with Entry:

Event Pack

Sapphire Pack

Regional Binder

Deck Lists:
All deck lists must be submitted online prior to the event via:
https://omni.gatcg.com/store/manage-events/41208

Prizing & Rewards:

Top 8 receive Regional Invite Cards

Cash prizing scales with attendance

Under 50 players: Cash prizing paid to Top 4

80+ players: Cash prizing paid to Top 8

100+ players: $1,000 total prize pool, with increases as attendance grows

Whether you’re chasing an invite or testing your mettle against top competitors, this is an event you won’t want to miss. Bring your best deck and let’s make it a regional to remember!
